{{Top|leg}}
'''Continuity of Service''' was a sort of "unofficial nepotism" seen in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. It allowed successive generations of the same family to serve in the same units. It was particularly evident during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], when "noob" [[Anson Trask]] was allowed to join the [[Joker Squad]] of the [[407th Stormtrooper Division]], since [[Anson Trask's father|his father]] had served in the unit in the past.
